hukuk.aciklama: Clients and matters, hearing and deadline tracking, time and expense records, and a private information link for clients.
hukuk.aciklamaYonetici: Support view: because of attorney–client privilege, only counts are shown.
hukuk.uyap: Nothing is pulled automatically from UYAP: it has no open interface and no scraping is done. The office enters matter details.
hukuk.bilgilendirme: These tools are for information only and are not legal advice.

ortak.kopyalanamadi: Could not copy; select the link manually.
ortak.silindi: Deleted; you can restore it from Settings › Deleted within {{gun}} days.
ortak.zorunlu: Please fill in the required fields.

muvekkil.secin: Select a client or add a new one.
muvekkil.vergiNoIpucu: Tax number, national ID or foreign ID/tax number; used for the conflict-of-interest check.

portal.aciklama: With this link the client sees only the information you mark as visible to the client and can leave a message. Share it only with the client; renewing it disables the old one.

catisma.aciklama: This is a warning and does not block saving. Please review the matches.
catisma.gizli: There is a match in a confidential matter; ask the account owner for details.

dosya.once: Add a client first to open a matter.
dosya.sinirDolu: The open matter limit has been reached ({{sinir}}).

alan.gizliIpucu: Only the account owner and the responsible lawyer can see it; other team members cannot.

portal.acik: Show this matter in the client portal
portal.notIpucu: This text is shown on the client's link.
portal.gizlilik: Notes, opposing parties, case number, court and time entries are never shown in the portal.

takvim.icsIpucu: The ICS file contains the selected lawyer's events from the last 30 days and the next year; import it into your phone or computer calendar.

sure.adliTatil: Apply judicial recess (Civil Procedure Code Art. 104)
sure.adliTatilIpucu: Turn this off for matters that proceed during the recess (e.g. urgent matters).
sure.tatilNotu: Public holidays come from the list in Settings: fixed national days are included; you must add the Ramadan and Sacrifice holidays yourself each year.
sure.sonucMetni: The period ends at the close of business on this day.

kural.hmk92: Art. 92: the starting day is not counted; week/month periods end on the corresponding day, or on the last day of the month if there is none → {{tarih}}
kural.hmk93: Art. 93: the last day fell on a public holiday or weekend; moved to the next working day → {{tarih}}
kural.hmk104: Art. 104: the period fell within the judicial recess; extended by {{gun}} days from the end of the recess ({{bitis}}) → {{tarih}}

uyari.adli_tatil_icinde: The last day falls within the judicial recess; check whether the matter is subject to the recess.
uyari.yarim_gun: The last day is a half-day holiday (eve); the period may end at midday.

sure.not: The calculation is an aid; the lawyer confirms the exact deadline. It is for information only and is not legal advice.
sure.olayEkle: Add to calendar as a deadline

masraf.tahsilatYok: No payment is collected; the statement is for information only.

belge.boyutIpucu: Up to {{mb}} MB; PDF, Office, image and text files.
belge.baglantiYok: There are no documents to link in Documents (the module may be off).

mesaj.aciklama: Messages from the client portal appear here; they do not go to the agency inbox. Your reply appears on the client's link; no email is sent.

ayar.hatirlatmaIpucu: How many days before to remind (0 = morning of the day). Each reminder is sent once per event; as a panel notification if email is not configured.
ayar.adliVarsayilan: Judicial recess on by default in the deadline calculator
ayar.yasalNot: Defaults follow Civil Procedure Code Art. 102 (20 July–31 August) and Art. 104 (one week); update them here if the law changes. For information only, not legal advice.

tatil.aciklama: Fixed national days (Law No. 2429) are already added. The Ramadan and Sacrifice holidays change every year, so you must add them yourself; mark the eves as half days.

silinenler.aciklama: Deleted clients and matters can be restored within {{gun}} days, then they are removed permanently.

yonetim.gizlilik: Attorney–client privilege: this screen shows counts only. Matter content, notes, documents and client personal data are never returned by admin endpoints.

hata.genel: Something went wrong. Please try again.
hata.cok_hizli: Too fast; wait a few seconds.
hata.zorunlu: Please fill in the required fields.
hata.vergi_no_gecersiz: Invalid tax/ID number (5–20 letters or digits).
hata.aralik_disi: The value must be between {{en_az}} and {{en_cok}}.
hata.bitis_once: The end cannot be before the start.
hata.muvekkilin_dosyasi_var: The client has {{sayi}} matters; delete them first.
hata.muvekkil_silindi: The client was deleted; restore the client first.
hata.gizli_erisim_kaybi: Only the account owner and the responsible lawyer see a confidential matter; make yourself responsible before marking it confidential.
hata.sorumlu_gecersiz: The responsible lawyer must have the law office permission on this account.
hata.baglanti_paylasilamaz: A Documents link cannot be shared in the portal; upload the file instead.
hata.modul_kapali: The law office module is off for this account.
hata.hesap_izni_yok: You do not have permission for this section.
hata.depo_hatasi: The file could not be stored.
hata.tur_izinsiz: This file type is not supported.
hata.icerik_uyusmuyor: The file content does not match its extension.
hata.tatil_listesi_gecersiz: The holiday list is invalid (more than 60 consecutive days).
